blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Visayas grid will once again be placed under red and yellow alerts on Tuesday, Oct. 27, due to insufficient power supply, the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) said. In an advisory, the NGCP said the red alert would be in effect from 5 p.m. to 6 p.m., while yellow alerts would be in effect from 4 p.m. to 5 p.m. and from 6 p.m. to 9 p.m. The NGCP said a red alert is issued when the power supply is insufficient to meet consumer demand and the grid’s regulating requirements, while a yellow alert means […]...
